scope: canonical payout schedule compilation, parsing, and commitment only

decisions.recipient_pubkey_uniqueness: recipient_pubkey MUST appear in at most one schedule entry, regardless of role
decisions.limit_compatibility: Increasing either V1 limit requires a new wire version or profile

cases.description: Different source order produces identical normalized entries, bytes, and commitment.
A contracted validator remains in the root schedule with zero bps and creates no positive payout leg.
Exactly 10,000 auxiliary basis points is valid and yields a zero seller remainder.
Validators with the same role sort by decoded recipient pubkey bytes, independent of source order.
Exactly 16 maximum-width validator entries satisfy the V1 count limit; aggregate allocation remains below 10,000 bps.
Exactly 16 globally unique recipients across validator and V4V roles satisfy the V1 count limit.
